purpose: Numerical planner-context diagnosis from exact offline reconstruction of public NCI01; no implementation change or new model call.
review_scope: Separate AI review of a known source-inspected development case. Failed execution; no analytic report or public acceptance.

method.exact_request_replay: Saved actions replayed through actual local stdio MCP against bound data; model transport replaced by non-network replay returning only saved actions. All ten canonical full-generation-request hashes and canonical/wire byte counts matched original records. Temporary reconstruction checkpoints discarded.
method.source_results: Actual complete tool results reconstructed from hash-bound sources; original trace, observed/retrieved IDs, progress and initial prompt hash matched.
method.token_counts: Original runtime preflight counts and reported generation usage only; no new tokenizer or model call. Nine completed prompt counts matched exactly.
method.delta_scope: Each difference is between successive full-request prompt counts. It includes the prior action, returned result, feedback and any changed response schema; it is not an isolated source-text or tool-result tokenizer benchmark.
method.byte_encoding: Canonical compact sorted JSON, ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8 unless a narrower measurement explicitly states otherwise. Source-text strings remain exact.
method.saving_limits: Candidate layouts measured offline only, not implemented or model-tested. Byte changes are not measured token/latency savings. Candidate measurements use different representation layers and are not additive as a measured combined-request saving.

final_request_components.qualification: These nested measurements overlap or exclude container punctuation; do not sum as a partition of total bytes.

candidate_byte_measurements.change: Compact outer JSON in structured tool-result text blocks; preserve all original values, including exact source text strings.
Replace catalog card objects by one column list plus value rows; exact round-trip back to every original card value checked.
candidate_byte_measurements.layer: Canonical first catalog response body, not complete model request

candidate_byte_measurements.change: Remove duplicated argument-schema fields from system TOOLS_JSON; retain tool names/descriptions and authoritative per-request action schema.
candidate_byte_measurements.layer: UTF-8 json.dumps tool-description list using default separators, before outer request string escaping

diagnosis: Exact-repeat deduplication and FastMCP text/structured payload selection already avoid whole-result duplication. Retained unique source records and metadata pages dominate growth. Compact final synthesis runs only after finish and still includes all unique full records. Large-context admission increases finite capacity but does not bound cumulative planner history.
next_boundary: If needed, first qualify reversible planner presentation changes with exact reconstruction and actual token measurements. Sustained scale requires durable exact result/version storage, bounded planner working sets and explicit cache rereads. Beyond final-context capacity, chunked synthesis needs complete cited-source bundles and cross-chunk contradiction/qualification review. IDs/hashes preserve provenance, not semantic correctness.
